rationale: The 2026-09-27 classical motion pass dropped four audited scopes from this article: that constructing the collision-constrained space does not become impossible beyond a fixed number of dimensions (motion-planning row 3 of audit/classical.md), that the RRT exploration properties do not guarantee fast coverage on every problem (row 6), that the Informed RRT* experiments do not establish a universal speedup (row 10), and that the improving-path statement is the paper's own description of its Sample routine, stronger than its admissible-superset construction supports (row 10). The verbatim pre-rewrite sentences put the article over the 2-per-1,000-word structural-tell floor and were reverted, so these four exact edits state the same limits plainly, without contrasts or section locators; the measured rate is 1.6 per 1,000 words. Every other sentence, number, citation (in order), mount and the frontmatter are byte-preserved. The archived pre-restore bytes are exactly the after endpoint of the round-5 first-screen mount move, whose review still gates them against the release dependency review; the live article keeps that review's preserved text. No proof, receipt, verdict or ledger cell changed.
